summary: Iteration 5 frontend regression + 13 new pages validation. Discovered and FIXED a critical env-config regression — REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env was pointing at the frontend preview URL (https://slang-commerce.preview.emergentagent.com) instead of the external API host (https://network-pay-1.emergent.host). This caused EVERY login (regular + admin) to POST /api/auth/login to the frontend, which returned 404, surfacing the chip 'Not Found' on the Login screen and blocking ALL downstream flows. After restoring REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://network-pay-1.emergent.host and restarting frontend, both regular (Test@gmail.com / Just@4me) and admin (support@networkrupay.com / Nlee@1115) logins succeed and land on /dashboard. Admin screenshot confirms the full sidebar — 12 user items (Dashboard, Shop, Wishlist, Services, My bookings, Slang-Connect, Wallet, Network, My shop, Support, KYC, Profile) + 10 ADMIN items (Analytics, Users, Approvals, KYC review, Withdrawals, Tickets, Products, Orders, Broadcast, Branding) all visible. After the fix, the rest of the suite is overwhelmingly green: NEW PAGES — Wishlist renders + wl-card-<id> appears after pd-save click on a product detail (wl_cards=1 after save); pd-save and pd-interested buttons present on ProductDetail; KYC page exposes kyc-main/status/name/aadhaar/pan/aadhaar-front/aadhaar-back/pan-image/selfie (kyc-submit not found — likely conditionally rendered or different testid); Tickets page has tk-new; ServiceBookings has sb-role-customer/sb-role-provider (sb-list testid not present when list is empty for Test user); BecomeProvider full form (bp-name/pincode/charge/desc/submit) present; BecomeVendor full form (bv-shop/gst/pan/bank-name/bank-acc/bank-ifsc/desc/submit) present; VendorDashboard vd-new present; Legal /legal/terms and /legal/privacy both render legal-content; Wallet wallet-transfer button opens wt-modal containing wt-recipient/wt-amount/wt-note/wt-submit AND wt-err is shown when submitted empty — wallet-transfer modal is fully wired; Profile More section has all 6 testids pf-go-kyc/provider/vendor/support/terms/privacy; Role-gating works (regular user navigating to /admin/analytics gets bounced — confirmed via URL containing /dashboard). ADMIN — /admin/analytics shows aa-stats + aa-range-7/30/90; /admin/approvals shows ap-tab-pending/approved/rejected; /admin/kyc shows kyca-table; /admin/withdrawals shows wd-table + wd-tab-pending; /admin/tickets shows at-stats + at-table. Console regression — grep across src confirms ZERO `console.*` calls outside src/lib/log.js. ONLY BUG remaining: Sidebar nav items do NOT carry the expected data-testid='nav-<label>' / 'admin-nav-<label>' attributes (all 22 lookups returned 0 even though labels render). Layout.jsx needs to be updated so each <NavLink>/<li> has data-testid='nav-<label>' and admin items 'admin-nav-<label>'. (Iter-4 report claimed these testids existed — they may have been refactored away.)

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/.env had REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://slang-commerce.preview.emergentagent.com (the frontend's own preview URL), so the React app's axios baseURL pointed at the same static-file host. Every /api/* request was served by the frontend's nginx as a SPA fallback or a 404, which the login page surfaces as 'Not Found'. REPRODUCTION: curl POST to https://network-pay-1.emergent.host/api/auth/login returns 200 + JWT (backend is healthy); the same POST aimed at https://slang-commerce.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/login returns 404. MITIGATION: Restored REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://network-pay-1.emergent.host in /app/frontend/.env and restarted the frontend supervisor process. All login flows recover immediately. Recommend: add a runtime guard (e.g., in src/lib/api.js) that throws/logs.warn if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL equals the current window.location.origin — that would have caught this drift instantly.
